VIRIDIS_RELIC_GARDENING_TOOLS.title: Gardener's Gloves
VIRIDIS_RELIC_GARDENING_TOOLS.descriptio: On the first turn of each combat, draw 1 additional card, then cultivate 1 card from your hand.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_GARDENING_TOOLS.flavor: Worn leather gloves, still carrying the smell of damp soil.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_GARDENING_TOOLS_UPGRADED.d: At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card, then cultivate 1 card from your hand.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_GARDENING_TOOLS_UPGRADED.f: Orobas polished the blades, and the gloves fit better than before.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_HARVEST_CHARM.title: Harvest Charm
VIRIDIS_RELIC_HARVEST_CHARM.description: The first time you harvest a card each combat, gain {Block} Block.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_HARVEST_CHARM.flavor: The first sprout gets the charm.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_CHLOROPHYLL.title: Chlorophyll
VIRIDIS_RELIC_CHLOROPHYLL.description: At the end of combat, overwrite this counter with your remaining [gold]Earworm[/gold] (positive) or [gold]Backlash[/gold] (negative) stacks. At the start of combat, gain that many stacks.
VIRIDIS_RELIC_CHLOROPHYLL.flavor: Even after the stream ends, chat's echo lingers into the next fight.
